description: List the workspace's stored files, newest first, a page at a time: each one's name, type, size, `sha256`, who stored it and `expiresAt`. Never the bytes. A key with a read list, or without the operate permission, sees, attaches and deletes only the files it stored itself. A file is kept while an unsent draft or a scheduled, reserved or sending email uses it, and deleted 7 days after it was stored or last used, or sooner with delete_file (409 serverErrors.filePinned while in use); reading or listing it doesn't change that. Attach up to 10 files by passing their ids as fileIds to create_draft, update_draft, draft_reply, reply_to_message or send_transactional_message.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_files
title: List stored files
